title: Usage Insights rollout monitoring checklist (SRE)
content:
Purpose
- Provide a repeatable SRE checklist for enabling “In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)” safely.
- Covers: pre-launch monitoring, feature-flag gates, ramp criteria, and rollback triggers.
- Audience: SRE oncall + Telemetry/Analytics + Console backend.

Scope
- Telemetry pipeline changes: ingest/emit `route` + `model` dimensions.
- Aggregations: hourly + daily rollups for cost/latency/error metrics.
- APIs: Insights route list + route detail + export job service.
- Console UI gates (feature flagged) and API/DB/query cost controls.

Quick links (dashboards / runbooks)
- Grafana: Usage Insights – Pipeline Health (lag, drop rate, consumer errors)
- Grafana: Usage Insights – API Health (p50/p95, error rate, cache hit rate)
- Grafana: Usage Insights – Export Jobs (success rate, duration, queue depth, timeouts)
- Grafana: Usage Insights – Cardinality / Route normalization (distinct route count, “unknown route” share)
- Runbook: Backfill and recompute usage insights aggregates
- SLO: Usage Insights APIs (availability + freshness targets)

Definitions / notes
- “Pipeline lag” = (now - event_time) at the point aggregates are queryable (not just ingestion into raw logs).
- “Freshness” = time until new requests appear in route/model aggregates.
- “Unknown route” = missing route tag or gateway couldn’t derive; shown as a bucket in UI.
- “Export job” = async report generation producing CSV + JSON with bounded rows/time range.

Owners / escalation
- SRE primary: Allison Grant (oncall rotation owns execution)
- Telemetry/Analytics: Logan Wright (EM), Nadia Rahman (cost attribution), Mei Lin (datasets)
- Console backend: Chloe Martin / Jada Williams
- Security/audit: Kevin Osei (export audit events), Marcus Lin (security review)

Pre-launch checklist (T-7 days to T-24 hours)

1) Deploy + config verification
[ ] Confirm latest PRs are deployed to staging and prod (as applicable):
    - Pipeline lag/export metrics dashboards (redwood/pr-15503 + observability-pack/pr-388)
    - Insights APIs and caching changes
    - Export job service w/ limits + retries
[ ] Confirm DB migrations/materialized views exist in prod, but feature is gated off:
    - Aggregates tables/views: hourly + daily
    - Partitioning/retention policies applied
[ ] Confirm API query cost limits are enabled (server-side):
    - Max time range for “top routes” query
    - Pagination defaults and hard maximums
    - Guardrail: reject unbounded filters (no “all orgs” style queries)

2) Alerting readiness
[ ] Alerts exist + are routed to the correct pager/channel:
    - Pipeline lag (warning + critical)
    - Insights API elevated 5xx
    - Export job failures/timeouts
    - Cardinality budget breach
[ ] Alert thresholds reviewed with Telemetry + Console backend (no noisy alerts during ramp).

3) Baseline measurements (prod, feature flag OFF)
Goal: ensure the new instrumentation and aggregation jobs aren’t destabilizing core infra before end-user exposure.
[ ] Pipeline ingestion errors: < 0.1% of events over 1h window
[ ] Pipeline consumer crashloop: 0 sustained crashloops
[ ] Raw-to-aggregate freshness (shadow):
    - p50 <= 5 min
    - p95 <= 15 min
[ ] Aggregate job durations (hourly rollup job): p95 <= 2 min
[ ] Aggregate job backlog: steady-state (queue depth not monotonically increasing)

4) Cardinality + normalization validation
[ ] Confirm route normalization rules are active (length limit, allowed chars, truncation rules).
[ ] Validate distinct route counts on representative orgs (shadow):
    - “distinct(route)” per org per day within budget (target: <= 10k; hard stop: > 25k)
[ ] Validate “Unknown route” share on dogfood orgs:
    - target <= 20% of requests after SDK tagging is enabled internally
    - investigate if > 40% (likely missing SDK/gateway config)
[ ] Confirm hashing/rollup behavior for excessive cardinality (if implemented) is reflected in output consistently.

5) API health baseline (prod, endpoints enabled but UI + customer flag OFF)
[ ] /usage-insights/routes (top routes) p95 <= 400ms at steady load
[ ] /usage-insights/routes/{routeId} p95 <= 500ms
[ ] Insights API error rate (5xx) <= 0.5% over 30m
[ ] Cache hit rate is non-zero and stable for common queries (sanity: > 30% for repeated dashboard loads)
[ ] DB read utilization: no sustained saturation; query planner uses expected indexes/partitions

6) Export job readiness
[ ] Export job success rate >= 99% over internal test runs
[ ] Export job duration p95 <= 45s for “typical” bounded export (e.g., 7 days, top N routes)
[ ] Export job duration p95 <= 120s for worst-case allowed export bounds
[ ] Export size limits enforced (CSV row cap + byte cap); confirm error message is actionable
[ ] Audit logging events emitted for export creation + download (verify required fields present)

7) Comms / operational prep
[ ] Launch channel established (e.g., #usage-insights-launch) with SRE + Telemetry + Console backend + PM present.
[ ] Rollback owner assigned for each component:
    - Feature flag rollback (Console) – Dylan Brooks / Console oncall
    - API feature disable – Chloe Martin
    - Pipeline/aggregation job disable – Nadia Rahman / Mei Lin
[ ] Runbook links pinned in channel.

Launch checklist (T-0)

A) Enablement plan (feature flag gates)
We use staged rollout by org allowlist + percentage (where supported), with hard stop criteria.

Gate 0: Internal dogfood (Redwood org only)
[ ] Enable UI flag for Redwood internal org (and only internal).
[ ] Monitor for 60 minutes.
Exit criteria:
- Insights API 5xx <= 0.5% (60m)
- Pipeline freshness p95 <= 15m
- No cardinality alerts
- Export job success >= 99% (if exercised)

Gate 1: Beta allowlist (design partners)
[ ] Enable for beta allowlist (per PM-613 list) during staffed hours.
[ ] Keep a “kill switch” ready (single flag that hides UI + blocks exports if needed).
Monitor for 4–24 hours depending on traffic.
Exit criteria:
- Insights API p95 within SLO target (see SLO doc) AND no sustained regression vs baseline (>20% increase)
- Error rate stable and not correlated to specific regions
- Export job failures not exceeding 1% (rolling 4h), no widespread timeouts
- Distinct route count for any beta org not exceeding hard stop; if exceeded, reach out with naming guidance

Gate 2: Gradual ramp (wider set of orgs)
[ ] Increase exposure in steps (example): 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over multiple days.
[ ] Each step requires a 2h observation window minimum.
Exit criteria at each step:
- No critical alerts fired in the prior 2h
- DB/query cost within budget; no p95 explosion on top routes endpoint
- Export queue depth stable; no backlog growth

B) Launch-day monitoring checklist (what to watch live)

1) Pipeline
[ ] Freshness p50/p95 (target p50<=5m, p95<=15m)
[ ] Drop rate / invalid events (route parsing failures)
[ ] Consumer lag (Kafka/queue offsets) and restart rate
[ ] Late-arriving metering events volume (watch for spikes after deploy)

2) Aggregations
[ ] Hourly rollup job duration and failures
[ ] Materialized view refresh time (if applicable)
[ ] Backlog indicators (queue depth)

3) APIs
[ ] Request volume by endpoint (routes list, route detail, exports)
[ ] p95 latency by endpoint and by region
[ ] Error rate (4xx vs 5xx). Pay attention to:
    - 429 spikes (rate limits too strict / UI retry loops)
    - 400 spikes (filter parsing / invalid time ranges)
[ ] DB saturation / query concurrency

4) Exports
[ ] Export job create rate (could spike after enablement)
[ ] Job duration distribution; watch for tail timeouts
[ ] Failures by reason (size limit vs timeout vs auth)
[ ] Download errors (signed URL expiry / permissions)

5) Cardinality + customer experience signals
[ ] Distinct routes per org per hour/day
[ ] “Unknown route” share trending up post-rollout
[ ] Top routes endpoint returning truncated results due to limits (ensure UI messaging is correct)

Rollback triggers (hard stops)
Triggering ANY of the below requires immediate pause of rollout (no further gates) and may require rollback.

1) Data correctness / tenant isolation
- Any evidence of cross-org or cross-project data leakage (SEV-0; immediate disable).
- Audit logging missing required fields for export events in prod (compliance issue).

2) Availability / latency
- Insights API 5xx > 2% for 10 minutes OR sustained > 1% for 30 minutes.
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for 30 minutes AND correlated with DB saturation.
- Export create/download endpoints causing cascading failures in shared services.

3) Pipeline freshness regression
- Freshness p95 > 30 minutes for 30 minutes (unless there is a known upstream incident).
- Aggregation backlog monotonically increasing for > 60 minutes.

4) Export job instability
- Export job failure rate > 5% for 30 minutes.
- Export queue depth growing without recovery AND jobs hitting timeout limits.

5) Cardinality breach
- Any single org exceeds hard stop distinct route threshold (e.g., >25k/day) AND this is causing system impact (DB pressure / lag).
- Route normalization failures spike (e.g., invalid route strings) causing ingestion/aggregation errors.

Rollback actions (ordered)
1) Stop exposure
[ ] Disable UI feature flag globally (or revert to previous gate) to stop customer traffic amplification.
[ ] Disable export UI entrypoints (if separate flag) to reduce heavy workloads.

2) Protect core systems
[ ] Apply emergency rate limits for insights endpoints (server-side) if needed.
[ ] Tighten max time range / max rows on exports temporarily.

3) Disable backend components if required
[ ] Disable export job worker (if it is the primary pressure source) while leaving read-only dashboards available.
[ ] Pause aggregation refresh jobs if they are causing DB saturation (note: this impacts freshness).

4) Communicate
[ ] Post update in #usage-insights-launch with: trigger, action taken, current status, next update time.
[ ] If customer-visible impact: coordinate with Support (Dev Patel) for status page / customer messaging.

5) Follow runbooks
[ ] Use Backfill/recompute runbook if rollback involves schema changes or partial aggregates.

Post-launch (24–72 hours)
[ ] Validate support load: monitor for tickets about invoice mismatch, unknown route dominance, and missing model breakdown.
[ ] Confirm dashboard retention and export retention align with policy.
[ ] Verify no drift in freshness and that alert thresholds remain appropriate.
[ ] Log “lessons learned” notes + threshold tuning suggestions in the launch channel thread.

Appendix: Suggested threshold defaults (starting point)
- Pipeline freshness: p50 <= 5m, p95 <= 15m (warning at p95>15m, critical at p95>30m)
- Insights API 5xx: warning at >1% (15m), critical at >2% (10m)
- Insights API latency: warning if p95 > 2x baseline (30m)
- Export jobs: warning if failure >2% (30m), critical if >5% (30m); warning if p95 duration >120s
- Cardinality: warning at >10k distinct routes/org/day, critical at >25k distinct routes/org/day

Notes / open questions (tracked separately)
- Confirm final GA ramp step sizes + staffed-hours requirement with PM (Paula Mendes).
- Decide whether export worker should be auto-scaled vs capped during first week of GA.
- Confirm whether “unknown route” should be excluded from top drivers by default in initial UI (product decision) vs always visible.
